selection.name: Cross-Model Navigation Usability Review
selection.goal: Review consumer discoverability of the published cross-model products and deterministic offline workspace, determine whether the workspace index needs a dedicated cross-model entry point, and define one bounded implementation recommendation without changing comparison semantics in the review package.
review_questions: Can a consumer discover the cross-model view directly from the deterministic workspace index?
Can model families and reporting scopes be reached without knowing generated file paths?
Do labels, navigation paths and provenance communicate the scope-preserving comparison boundary clearly?
What is the smallest testable implementation package that improves discoverability without changing comparison semantics?
